title: A title page at the start pushes the recording after it instead of covering it
goal: When a person puts a title page at the very start of a recording, the recording starts after the title (overlapping only for the dissolve) rather than playing hidden underneath it, so the basic edit of title, dissolve into the recording loses none of the footage.
notes: Follow-up from insert-title-pages-and-name-cards-on-the-timelin. Seen in Scripts/playtest/title-pages-and-name-cards-walk.json: the Midnight page at 0 to 4s covers Tutorial Sample 0 to 3.5s (3-dissolve shot). The user asked for title page, cross fade to recording (task notes). Premiere puts the title on V1 before the clip with a dissolve at the cut; Final Cut connects the title and the editor ripples. Could be the same insert with a ripple (look for an existing ripple insert in the cut code) or a decision card if it is not obvious which the user wants; the audit asks the question too.
acceptance: Inserting a title page at 0:00 over a recording that starts at 0:00 moves the recording (and everything after it on its track) later by the title length less its fade out, in one undo step
The title page fades out over the recording start, so the picture goes title, dissolve, recording with no frame of the recording lost
Inserting anywhere else still overlays, as today
A walk at Next defaults photographs the first frame of the recording right after the dissolve

log.note: Adversarial pass: Premiere puts an opening title on V1 ahead of the clip with a dissolve at the cut; a Final Cut user expects the ripple. Risk: an implicit push surprises someone who meant an overlay, so it is limited to exactly 0:00 over a picture that starts there, title pages only, unlocked tracks, one undo step.

Reproduced first: TitlePageAtStartTests failed with the recording at 0 under the page; now 7 pass, full suite 11136 passed. Walks title-pages-and-name-cards-walk (3-dissolve at 3.75s, 3b-recording-starts at 4.0s, clips 3.50-11.40 and 11.40-19.40), title-presets-menu-bar-walk, -gallery-walk, -library-shelf-walk all ok at Next defaults. Undo/redo verified in the probe (/tmp/tp-undo-probe.json: one undo puts the recording back at 0 and removes the page).

Menu-bar walk: 'Title Page clip' field is not registered for the loose title row once the recording moved (checked old vs new build side by side: identical on screen), so the walk now uses 'Timing Title Page' like the end-to-end walk. Left rough, not filed: a walk-name quirk only an agent sees.

Filed an-opening-title-page-keeps-its-dissolve-onto-th (p2, reproduced): lengthening the page's fade out after the insert dims toward black for the extra time; Ripple Delete on the page folded in. Audit rough items: those two went to that task; the 0:00-only and locked-track notes are described behaviour.
